## Safety boundary

- Do not delete rows directly from `supabase_migrations.schema_migrations`.
- Repair the remote migration history with the supported Supabase CLI command.
- Only after repair succeeds should the live schema be pulled as the new baseline.
- Never run `supabase db reset --linked` against production.
